shorts_extract.hook: Watch a silent 5-second clip of a stranger scratching an arm, and 64% of healthy adults start scratching their own clean skin — and it has ZERO to do with empathy.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Holle, Seth, Critchley & Ward (2012 PNAS, N=51 behavioral / N=18 fMRI, scratching vs tapping) + Mochizuki & Yosipovitch (2017) + Yu & Chen (2017 Science) mouse circuit.
shorts_extract.twist: Trait stress vigilance (neuroticism), not empathy, drives the insula-premotor-somatosensory itch alarm — an ancient parasite-defense radar you can calm with cool pressure.
